title: Nifty snaps four-day losing streak at 22,753 as metals and pharma lead a late rebound
short: Nifty ends 4-day slide at 22,753; metals, pharma lead
dek: The market opened lower on high oil prices, then recovered more than 1,000 Sensex points from the day's low. Mid and small caps ended seven days of losses.
card: Nifty +153.20 at 22,753.20, Sensex +482.92 at 73,606.75. Dr Reddy's and JSW Steel jumped over 6%; Shriram Finance fell 4.6%.
